name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It sets out what it wants the European Commission and member states to do for industries that use a lot of energy, such as steel, cement, chemicals and glass. It asks for faster permits for clean energy, lower and steadier electricity prices, more support for switching to clean technology, and protection from unfair competition from outside the EU. It also wants help for workers and regions affected by the shift.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking the Commission and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Energy-heavy industries, their workers, and the regions where they are based.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to follow these requests.
